message: The other day, a storm rolled in, and I found myself rummaging through the pantry for supplies. I thought I was ready, but all I could find was a can of green beans and a box of stale crackers. I mean, what was I thinking? If the power went out, I’d be dining on a gourmet meal of disappointment! It’s funny how the idea of being prepared can quickly turn into a scavenger hunt. I suppose it’s a good reminder to check what’s actually in my emergency stash. What's the most unexpected thing you've found in your pantry during a storm?
